node.statement: By a=h*u, bilinearity gives Y^dagger(aY)=h*Y^dagger(uY). Node 1.1 gives ||uY-Y||<=C0*e*s, so the product bound and |h|<=C_h*r^2 from node 1.2 imply ||h*Y^dagger(uY)-h*Y^dagger Y||<=C_u*e*r^2*s^2. Summing the three errors proves node 1.3.2 with C4=C_as+C_a+C_u.
